items.title: Cloudflare 将 1.1.1.1 DNS 缓存的内存占用削减了 100TB
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 重新设计了 1.1.1.1 解析器 DNS 缓存的内存表示，每个缓存条目的基准占用减少 56%，整个集群释放约 100 TB 工作集内存。其 Big Pineapple 平台插入吞吐提升 43%，查询延迟下降 19%，p99 单实例常驻内存从 9.3 GB 降至 5.3 GB；改动经过五次 Rust 迭代，最终以 DNS 有线格式把记录写入连续字节缓冲区，避免枚举与逐记录分配。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare redesigned the in-memory representation of the DNS cache behind its 1.1.1.1 resolver, cutting per-entry baseline footprint by 56% and freeing roughly 100 TB of working-set memory across the fleet. On its Big Pineapple platform, cache insert throughput rose 43% and query latency fell 19%, with p99 per-instance RSS dropping from 9.3 GB to 5.3 GB. Five Rust iterations replaced Vec/String with boxed slices, packed booleans into bitflags, and finally stored records in a contiguous wire-format byte buffer, avoiding enum and per-record allocation overhead.

items.title: 一边是 WebGPU 视觉革命，一边是浏览器垄断争议：Canvas UI 发布 35 个组件
items.summary_zh: Canvas UI 是 React Bits 作者 David Haz 推出的开源组件库，也是首个基于实验性 HTML-in-Canvas API 构建的组件库，含 35 个组件，用实时 DOM 布局配合 GLSL/WebGPU 着色器实现流体、火焰、玻璃透镜、VHS 颗粒等特效，文本仍可选、链接仍可点。它以兼容 shadcn 的注册表按源码分发，完整体验需在 Chrome 中启用 canvas-draw-element 标志或使用 Chrome 148–150 的源试用令牌，适合关注 WebGPU 与前端渲染前沿的开发者。
items.summary_en: Canvas UI is an open-source component library from React Bits author David Haz and the first built on the experimental HTML-in-Canvas API. Its 35 components — pointer-driven fluids, flames, glass lenses, ASCII filters, VHS grain — ship in both GLSL/WebGL and WGSL/WebGPU versions with wrappers for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Preact. Effects lay out live DOM in canvas via drawElementImage, so text stays selectable and links clickable. The full experience needs Chrome's canvas-draw-element flag or an origin trial token (Chrome 148–150); components are distributed as source through a shadcn-compatible registry.

items.summary_zh: lsearch 是一款开源桌面全文搜索工具，可为指定目录下的 27 种格式建立本地索引，涵盖 Word/Excel/PowerPoint、WPS、PDF、EPUB/MOBI/AZW3 等电子书与源码，支持 Google 式 AND/OR、排除、精确短语和 path: 过滤，并用中文双字切分让两字词也能命中。它基于 Go + Wails v2 + React 19、Bleve 倒排索引加 SQLite，全程离线、无账号无遥测；不做 OCR，扫描版 PDF 和带 DRM 的电子书搜不到。
items.summary_en: lsearch is an open-source desktop full-text search tool that indexes 27 file formats across directories you choose, covering Word/Excel/PowerPoint, WPS, PDF, EPUB/MOBI/AZW3 ebooks and source code. It supports Google-style AND/OR, exclusion, exact phrases, path and name filters plus RE2 regex, and a CJK bigram scheme that matches two-character Chinese queries. Built with Go, Wails v2 and React 19 on a Bleve inverted index and SQLite, it runs fully offline with no account or telemetry; OCR and DRM-protected ebooks aren't supported.

items.title: MCP 终于无状态了，但状态并没有消失，只是被“甩”给了应用
items.summary_zh: 新版 MCP 规范移除了协议层会话，删掉 initialize 握手与 Mcp-Session-Id 标头，请求可被任意服务器实例处理，AWS 称这免去了粘性会话与共享会话存储，也让 Lambda 这类请求—响应式部署更合适。文章强调协议无状态不等于应用无状态，副作用工具调用需保证幂等，Apify 则同时实现有会话与无状态两版以便过渡。
items.summary_en: A new MCP specification drops protocol-level sessions, removing the initialize/initialized handshake and the Mcp-Session-Id header so any server instance can handle a request. AWS notes this eliminates sticky sessions and shared session storage, making Lambda-style request-response deployments viable. The write-up stresses that a stateless protocol doesn't make your application stateless, that side-effecting tools need idempotency, and that Apify ships both sessionful and stateless support to ease migration.

items.title: 用 Harness 工程打造 SRE 可控的生产环境｜QCon上海
items.summary_zh: 腾讯高级 SRE 工程师王杰将在 2026 年 QCon 上海站分享《用 Harness 工程打造 SRE 可控的生产环境》。他认为 LLM 的概率性与幻觉不会随模型变强而消失，只能用 Harness 工程管控不确定性，并带来腾讯游戏的 GitOps 实践：让多个 SRE Agent 参与发布变更与故障修复，变更必经 Git 与人工 Review。
items.summary_en: Wang Jie, a senior SRE engineer at Tencent, will speak at QCon Shanghai (Oct 22–24, 2026) on using Harness engineering to keep SRE-run production controllable. His argument is that LLM output is probabilistic and hallucination-prone and that this gap won't close as models improve, so the fix is constraining uncertainty rather than chasing determinism. He'll share Tencent Games' GitOps setup, where multiple SRE agents handle releases and incident fixes behind a guardrail forcing every change through Git and human review.
